tools.description: Start here: open world, maps, active map/layer, your pending edit, references (pictures), smart sources (smart) and essential limits. Pass transactionId to poll an edit's outcome.
tools.name: get_session

tools.description: Map size, tile size and layers (id, name, kind, visible, locked).
tools.name: get_map_info

tools.description: Read cells as paint_grid-shaped rows+legend per layer ('.' = empty); default whole map, visible tile+collision layers. format:'cells' gives flat arrays.
tools.name: read_region

tools.description: Tilesets with tile size, grid and detected smart sources. includeDetails:false skips fingerprints (faster).
tools.name: list_tilesets

tools.description: PNG of a tileset with every tileId printed under its tile (image:'tiles', default), or a sheet crop (image:'sheet', sheetRegion). details:true adds fingerprints for set_tags.
tools.name: get_tile_catalog

tools.description: Saved stamps (multi-layer objects: houses, bridges, trees) with size and source layers. includeSheet:true returns one PNG of all stamps with names and sizes; query searches names/tags.
tools.name: list_stamps

tools.description: Open your draft on mapIds (requestLabel = the user's request). Returns transactionId and resumeToken (keep it). unlockLayerIds lets you paint locked/hidden layers. collaboration:{mode:'regions'} starts a shared draft.

mapIds.description: Map ids this edit may change (create_map adds more).

tools.name: begin_edit

tools.description: Submit the draft for the human's review (Onayla/Vazgeç). resume_edit reopens it if you must amend.
tools.name: finish_edit

tools.description: Discard your draft and restore everything. After a reconnect pass resumeToken.
tools.name: cancel_edit

tools.description: Sparse cells: points:[[x,y],...] with one value (cheapest scatter), or cells:[{x,y,value}]. value = tile, null (erase) or {collision:n}.
tools.name: paint_cells

tools.description: Fill a region with one value, or {random:[{tilesetId,tileId,weight?},...]} for natural ground (e.g. whole-map grass with 2–3 variants; stable per cell). outline:n for a frame. Any size.
tools.name: paint_rect

tools.description: Straight line from→to with one value; width 1–16.
tools.name: paint_line

tools.description: Flood fill from start (4-neighbour, same original value), optionally inside region. value may be {random:[...]} like paint_rect.
tools.name: fill

tools.description: Optional: prepare smart art once and get a sourceId. draw_path/smart_brush accept source directly.
tools.name: prepare_smart_source

tools.description: Smart bordered shapes with correct edges/corners. mode:'area' + region (lakes, ponds, fields; overlapping areas merge); mode:'road' + cells. source = {tilesetId,region} from get_session.smart, or {stampId}. openEdges (default true) keeps shapes open at the map border.
tools.name: smart_brush

tools.description: Roads, paths and rivers with smart edges: points are the bends (orthogonal runs join them), width in macro cells (3 suits a river). source = {tilesetId,region} from get_session.smart (kind road). Joins/crossings get matching corners; reaching the border runs off-map.
tools.name: draw_path

tools.description: Place a stamp (all its layers) with top-left at, or at every positions:[[x,y],...] in one call. rotation 0–3, flipX/flipY; layerMapping when layers are ambiguous.

positions.description: [[x,y],...] top-left cells; places the stamp at each.

tools.name: place_stamp

tools.description: Layers: action create {name,kind tile|collision|entity,index?}, update {layerId,props:{name,visible,locked,opacity}} or reorder {layerId,index}.
tools.name: edit_layer

tools.description: Entity types (spawn, portal, user types) with fields and defaults.
tools.name: list_entity_types

tools.description: Place an entity of typeId at a cell on an entity layer. Point fields are pixels.
tools.name: place_entity

tools.description: Create a new map inside your edit (width/height in cells, tile size in pixels); returns its id and layer ids.
tools.name: create_map

tools.description: Resize a map from its top-left; allowCrop:true to drop content outside.
tools.name: resize_map

tools.description: PNG of the live map (your draft included). grid/coordinates for labelled cells, region+zoom (1–8) for close-ups, highlight:'draft' outlines your changes.
tools.name: render_preview

tools.description: Structural check of the whole map in one call: summary by code plus the first issues.
tools.name: validate_map

tools.description: AI tags (free words like 'su', 'çatı-sol') of tiles/stamps; query searches them.
tools.name: get_tags

tools.description: Set AI tags for tiles/stamps (expectedFingerprint from get_tags or get_tile_catalog details). Saved immediately, outside the draft.
tools.name: set_tags

tools.description: Keep a base64 PNG for exact atlas matching with visual_match_reference (for pictures use reference_add).
tools.name: visual_ingest_reference

tools.description: Find where an ingested PNG appears exactly in tilesets (D4 flips, integer scales).
tools.name: visual_match_reference

tools.description: Save a stamp from a map region (layerIds) or a tileset region.
tools.name: create_stamp

tools.description: Take your draft back after a reconnect, restart, Durdur or finish_edit (transactionId + resumeToken). Earlier work is kept.
tools.name: resume_edit

tools.description: Paint any area of varied tiles in one call: rows (equal-length strings, one char per cell from origin, default 0,0) + legend char → tile | null (erase) | 'keep' | {random:[{tilesetId,tileId,weight?}],seed?} | {collision:n}. Space keeps a cell. layers:[{layerName|layerId,origin?,rows,legend?}] paints several layers at once. ≤16384 cells per layer.

legend.description: Same values as legend; merged over it.

proposalId.description: reference_quantize's proposalId: paints its grid.layers unchanged (no rows needed).

rows.description: One string per map row; all the same length.

tools.name: paint_grid

tools.description: Replace one tile with another (to:null erases) keeping flips; scope region|layer|map|world. Returns the count.
tools.name: replace_tiles

tools.description: Erase cells in region (default whole map) on layerIds or all visible unlocked tile/collision layers.
tools.name: clear_region

tools.description: What the user has selected in the editor (map, layer, tool, tileset selection, shared reference token).
tools.name: get_editor_context

tools.description: Move (at), update fields or remove an entity.
tools.name: edit_entity

tools.description: Run up to 32 paint_cells/paint_grid/paint_rect/paint_line/place_stamp/place_entity/edit_entity calls as one action: operations:[{tool,args}]. All-or-nothing; place_stamp children need layerMapping.
tools.name: apply_operations

tools.description: Check goals: reachability over collision layers, region_unchanged digests, entity_count.
tools.name: validate_goals

tools.description: Editor UI, not the map (no begin_edit): action state | configure {activeMapId, activeLayerId, tool, camera:{zoom,center,frame}, gridVisible, …} | layout {action reset|zone|show|hide|move, panel, zone} | application {locale, shortcuts} | commands {query} | run_command {commandId} | export_settings | configure_export {preferences}. args holds the action's arguments.
tools.name: editor_ui

tools.description: Rename a map or move it in the world view (world pixels).
tools.name: edit_map

tools.description: Stamp library: action update {props}, duplicate {name} or remove.
tools.name: edit_stamp

tools.description: World defaults for new maps (tile size, size, layer template, background).
tools.name: get_world_settings

tools.description: Change world defaults for new maps inside your edit.
tools.name: configure_world

tools.description: Join a shared (collaborative) draft claiming map/layer rectangles; then write with context.expectedMemberRevision.
tools.name: join_edit

tools.description: First step whenever the user gives a map picture (never trace it by eye). Load it: path (absolute .png/.jpg/.webp), imageBase64, or selectedReferenceToken. Pictures the user dropped are already in get_session.references.
tools.name: reference_add

tools.description: Show a reference picture resampled onto the map grid with coordinates, to read features as cells.
tools.name: reference_view

tools.description: Turn a reference picture into paint_grid layers (nearest tiles per cell) plus confidence and a preview; paint grid.layers with one paint_grid call. mode render|sketch|auto; colorLegend {'#rrggbb': tile | tag word | {stampId} | null} for sketches. Writes nothing.
tools.name: reference_quantize

tools.description: Compare the map with a reference (referenceId) or with the draft start (baseline:'draftStart'); mode side|overlay|diff; region crops the same cells of picture and map; returns mismatching cells. cells:true adds an error heatmap, stats and worst cells with alternatives for you to paint.
tools.name: render_compare
